title: Quarterly rollout playbook: Hosted API + Model Catalog staggered delivery and ops-readiness
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: produce a single, actionable quarterly playbook that sequences hosted API feature releases and model catalog rotations to minimize customer disruption while maximizing cost/perf improvements. This ticket captures the prioritization rationale, phased delivery timeline, ops readiness checklist, and rollback/fallback policies for the quarter.

Scope breakdown:
- Phase A (month 1): model catalog pruning and tagging, baseline perf measurements for candidate model variants, and canary sizing experiments.
- Phase B (month 2): staged hosted API feature toggles (structured responses + streaming adjustments) and rollout of first wave of model variants behind routing policies.
- Phase C (month 3): full fleet rollout, routing policy lock-ins, and post-release quality/regression monitoring.

Decisions & trade-offs made so far:
- Prioritized model variants that reduce median token cost by >= 18% with <=1.5% drop in rouge/semantic evals for target prompts. Trade-off: slightly higher 99th percentile latency on small-batch workloads; mitigation will be dynamic routing to lower-latency variants for latency-sensitive customers.
- Chosen a staggered rollout (per-region per-customer-tier) instead of global flip to preserve SLOs and allow rollback by cohort.
- Deferred aggressive quantization experiments to a follow-up cycle because operator visibility and eval tooling are not ready.

Acceptance criteria:
- Canary cohort (>=100 active API keys) runs for >=72 hours with no customer-facing regressions and observability signals within thresholds (error rate <0.2%, p95 latency < target).
- Model health metrics show no more than 1% degradation on customer-provided eval prompts and no more than 3% across internal prompt set.
- Billing telemetry validates cost improvements are in-line with projections (within +/-10%).

Rollout plan (high level):
1) Prep: create canary prompt set, update model metadata in catalog, publish migration notes to docs. (Owners: PM/Liam, Eng/Sasha)
2) Canary: enable for 5% of traffic in us-west, monitor for 72h, collect user feedback. (Eng oncall + PM review)
3) Expand: 20% across additional regions with targeted customers who opt-in to cost/reliability trade testing.
4) Full: gradual ramp to 100% across non-sensitive customers, schedule enterprise rollouts separately with account teams.

Ops-readiness checklist (must be green before expand):
- Tracing & dashboards: per-model route tracing added to Console (dashboard link below).
- Regression eval harness: nightly runs against the curated prompt set and alerting configured.
- Rollback test documented and practiced (runbook PR: github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/314).
- Customer comms: release notes + targeted emails prepared by Growth and Support.

Risk assessment and mitigations: 
- Risk: latent quality regressions on long-tail prompts. Mitigation: maintain fallback routing to older model variants and enable selective prompt-based exclusion scoring.
- Risk: billing spikes due to debug verbosity. Mitigation: default debug sampling off in canary and monitor token distribution closely.
- Risk: undocumented infra constraints in dedicated pools. Mitigation: coordinate with Dedicated infra lead and run capacity soak tests.

Open questions for exec sync: 
- Do we allow enterprise customers to opt into early quantized variants (higher cost savings) with a documented SLA deviation?
- Should cost savings targets be surfaced in OKR metrics or remain internal COGS-focused measurements?

- Canary runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/314
- Eval harness dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/eval-harness-q2
- Model catalog draft (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xQ-ModelCatalog-Q2

Next steps (owner assignments):
- PM: finalize prioritization table and communicate to stakeholders by 2025-02-18. (Owner: Liam Chen)
- Eng: complete canary instrumentation and add per-route cost telemetry by 2025-02-28. (Owner: Sasha Patel)
- Design: add UX copy for rollout toggles in Console by 2025-03-07. (Owner: Priya Rao)
- Support: draft customer-facing FAQ and escalation matrix by 2025-03-10. (Owner: Marco Silva)

Longer-term follow-ups: centralized per-token cost forecasting, policy for automatic fallback when model health drops below threshold, and a quarterly playbook improvements retro after the release.
